header: What fifty-eight people look like from the outside
lead: Counted in January, from the payroll rather than from the website. The tenure figure is the one that took us longest to be willing to publish.

stats.title: Across three offices
stats.text: Hollerau, Nauwang and Kettbach. Twenty-two of them are on a site in any given week.

stats.title: Median time people stay
stats.text: Measured over everyone who has left since 2010, not over the people still here — which flatters nobody.

stats.title: Apprentices trained since 1998
stats.text: Nineteen are still working in surveying. Six of them are still working here.

stats.title: Spoken on our sites
stats.text: German, Turkish, Czech and Hungarian. On a shared building site that matters more than it sounds.
